name: Pete Chrisp
current_positions: New Zealand Trade and Enterprise (NZTE) 首席执行官
Department of Conservation (DOC) 保育部总干事兼首席执行官（候任）
Port of Auckland Limited 董事

education.notes: Master of Arts (First Class Honours) in Social Sciences from Massey University. Also undertook additional study in law, marketing, strategy, accounting and finance at universities in New Zealand, Australia, the United Kingdom and Europe.

work_experience.title: Chief Executive
work_experience.organization: 新西兰贸易发展局(New Zealand Trade and Enterprise)
work_experience.description: Led NZTE for nearly 16 years, building the organisation's capacity to help New Zealand companies grow internationally and attract investment. Managed a global network of over 50 offices. In 2025, concurrently served as interim Chief Executive of Invest NZ during its establishment phase. Under his leadership, NZTE supported the growth of NZ-China bilateral trade to over NZ$40 billion.

work_experience.title: Interim Chief Executive
work_experience.description: Concurrently served as interim Chief Executive of Invest New Zealand, the newly established investment promotion agency within NZTE, during its transition to an independent Crown entity on 1 July 2025.

work_experience.title: Regional President
work_experience.description: Based in Sydney as Regional President of Norske Skog Australasia, manufacturing newsprint for New Zealand, Australia and Asian markets.

work_experience.title: Senior Vice President, Business Improvement
work_experience.description: Based at the global headquarters in Oslo, Norway, covering business in South America, Asia, the Middle East and Europe.

work_experience.title: General Manager
work_experience.description: General Manager of Tasman Paper mill in Kawerau, New Zealand, overseeing operations at one of the country's major pulp and paper facilities.

work_experience.title: Various roles
work_experience.organization: Fletcher Challenge / Pulp and Paper Industry
work_experience.description: Early career spanning 23 years in engineering, manufacturing, and pulp and paper industries, including roles in human resources, operations, logistics, supply chain, business improvement and general management. Started as a trade union educator before moving into human resources and operations management.

work_experience.notes: Chief Executive of NZTE since September/October 2010. Led the organisation's strategy, operations and international network supporting New Zealand businesses to grow globally. Departing in July 2026 to take up the Director-General of Conservation role.

work_experience.position: 保育部总干事兼首席执行官（候任）
work_experience.notes: Appointed by the Public Service Commission on 20 May 2026 as the new Director-General of Conservation and Chief Executive of DOC for a five-year term from 13 July 2026.
Serves as a Director of Port of Auckland Limited since 2021.

person_relationships.description: NZTE Board Chair who worked closely with Chrisp on organisational strategy and governance
Trade Minister who exercised ministerial oversight of NZTE during Chrisp's tenure
Chrisp was appointed to succeed Penny Nelson as Director-General of Conservation in May 2026

major_achievements.achievement: 担任NZTE首席执行官近16年：新西兰公共部门任职时间最长的首席执行官之一，领导NZTE经历了新西兰国际贸易显著增长时期，包括新中双边贸易额超过NZ$400亿，新西兰食品饮料对ASEAN出口达到NZ$84亿
被任命为保护部总干事：被公共服务委员会任命为保护部总干事兼DOC首席执行官，任期五年，自2026年7月13日起，因广泛的公共和私营部门领导经验而受到认可
以临时首席执行官身份建立Invest New Zealand：在Invest New Zealand于NZTE内建立期间担任临时首席执行官，推动其于2025年7月1日过渡为独立的自主皇家实体，完成了新西兰贸易和投资促进架构的重大结构性改革
担任Predator Free Wellington主席：担任Predator Free Wellington主席，这是一项旨在根除Wellington地区入侵性掠食者的重要保护倡议，展现了与保护和生物多样性成果相关的治理和领导能力

biography_summary: 彼得·克里斯普（Pete Chrisp，全名Peter Chrisp）是新西兰资深企业高管和公共服务领导者，出生于新西兰东海岸地区。他自2010年10月起担任新西兰贸易发展局（NZTE）首席执行官长达近16年，是新西兰公共部门任期最长的首席高管之一。2026年5月20日，新西兰公共服务委员会宣布任命他为新一任保育部（DOC）总干事兼首席执行官，任期五年，自2026年7月13日起生效。克里斯普拥有梅西大学社会科学一等荣誉硕士学位，并曾在新西兰、澳大利亚、英国和欧洲的大学进修法律、市场营销、战略、会计和金融等课程。他的职业生涯始于工会教育工作者，随后进入制造业领域，在工程、制造和纸浆造纸行业工作了23年。他曾在Kawerau的Tasman Paper担任总经理（2002-2006年），随后在挪威奥斯陆的Norske Skog International总部担任高级副总裁（2006-2009年），负责南美、亚洲、中东和欧洲业务。之后在悉尼担任Norske Skog Australasia区域总裁（2009-2010年），为新西兰、澳大利亚和亚洲市场生产新闻纸。2010年，克里斯普从私营部门转入公共服务领域，出任NZTE首席执行官。在他的领导下，NZTE构建了覆盖全球50多个国家和地区的办事处网络，每年为超过5,000家新西兰出口企业提供服务。他推动新中双边贸易突破400亿纽币，新西兰食品饮料对东盟出口达84亿纽币。2025年，他兼任新成立的Invest New Zealand临时首席执行官，完成了该机构从NZTE内部分拆为独立王室实体的重大制度改革。克里斯普在治理和公益领域同样活跃，曾担任新西兰学历认证局（NZQA）董事、澳大利亚纸浆造纸创新委员会成员、新西兰中国理事会成员、亚洲新西兰基金会成员和Te Hono董事会成员。他还担任Predator Free Wellington（惠灵顿无掠食者计划）主席，积极参与保育和生物多样性保护事业。自2021年起，他同时担任奥克兰港务局（Port of Auckland Limited）董事。公共服务委员会在任命声明中称赞他'在公共和私人领域拥有广泛的领导经验，在充满挑战的环境中领导大型组织的业绩斐然'，并指出他'理解保育如何为新西兰的国家认同、福祉和经济做出贡献'。
